title: Tea Prophet
description: The modification adds my friend "Cairairos". He can now appear in the world, but if you kill him, he will show his diabolical form.
body:
I have created a modification that adds my friend Cairairos to the world of our virtual adventure. This mysterious character can suddenly appear in various corners of the game world, bringing with him an atmosphere of mystery and intrigue.

However, be careful: if you decide to attack Cairairos, he will reveal his true, devilish form. In this guise, he becomes a bloodthirsty boss with an impressive 1,000 health points, ready to challenge you. His power and fury will make you sweat in battle, as he uses all his abilities to gain the upper hand.

But for defeating this powerful opponent, you will receive a generous reward — the best tea in the world. This unique drink not only restores your health and increases your gaming performance, but also gives you special bonuses that will help you in further adventures. Tea made from the rarest ingredients collected in the most inaccessible corners of the game world will become your faithful companion in the fight against other enemies and challenging quests.

So you're faced with a difficult dilemma: take a chance and fight Cairairos to test his power and get the coveted tea, or leave him alone and escape the wrath of the mystical creatures guarding him. Every choice you make will have consequences, and every encounter will have unique emotions. Immerse yourself in this exciting adventure and discover the world of Cairairos!

Mod from the series - Kentavrs
